meta.description: Receives blog post data from admin.hotbotstudios.com → validates session token → sends to Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-6) to generate or enhance content → publishes to hotbotstudios.com/api/blog/publish → notifies Telegram.

n8n_env_vars.ADMIN_TOKEN: Same value as in 08-blog-auth workflow. Long random string.
n8n_env_vars.BLOG_PUBLISH_SECRET: Same value as BLOG_PUBLISH_SECRET in hotbot-studios .env.local
n8n_env_vars.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: Your Telegram chat ID for publish notifications

credentials_needed: Anthropic API Key (httpHeaderAuth) — set header: x-api-key: sk-ant-...
